# Path-scoped rules (rename this file)

Copy to `your-topic.instructions.md` and set `applyTo` so rules load only on matching paths.

Keep each file focused — overlapping globs stack and increase input tokens.

## Example contract

1. One concern per file (API, tests, IaC).
2. Landmines only — patterns the agent cannot infer from code.
3. Output stays terse per `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.

Delete this `_template` file after copying; filenames starting with `_` are for kit authors only.
